title: fix(types): declare `hideEmpty` on the record:details section mirror and hold the member set to the spec (objectui#12348)
body:
Fixes #12348
Clause-②: yes — this widens the accept set of the published `@object-ui/types` type `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[]` by one member, `hideEmpty`, to follow the spec row. The seat's claim takes the stricter reading over triage's `no`, so a contract review is owed before the queue.

## Contract review: what the section type accepts, against the installed spec

The spec was measured at the PR head (`80506a725`, after merging `main` with objectui#12370): `@objectstack/spec` **18.0.0-next.1**. It was measured first at base `d75f21285` on **18.0.0-next.0**, and both versions declare the same thirteen section members. The member list was read off `RecordDetailsProps.shape.sections` element shape in `node_modules`, not copied from the card.

| spec `RecordDetailsProps.sections[]` member | spec type | `@object-ui/types` before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `label` | I18nLabel, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `columns` | int 1-4, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `group` | string, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `fields` | string array, optional | declared | unchanged |
| **`hideEmpty`** | **boolean, optional** | **missing (TS2353)** | **added, `boolean`** |
| `collapsible` | boolean, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `showBorder` | boolean, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `defaultCollapsed` | boolean, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `icon` | string, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `description` | string, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `headerColor` | six-token enum, optional | declared | unchanged |
| `count` | object with `field`, optional | declared | unchanged |

`hideEmpty` is the only member added, and nothing is removed. The type now declares exactly the spec's member set.

**Still refused on a typed section literal:** any key the spec does not declare on the section. That includes the retired `collapsed` (objectui#8583 item 2) and any misspelling. The type has no index signature, so excess-property checking still applies. The pin's `refusedByTsc` and `retiredSpellingRefusedByTsc` literals still compile only through their `@ts-expect-error` directives. Cross-key rules (`fields` versus `group`, `count` needing a label hole) stay the spec parser's job, the same as before. The type does not encode them.

**The ruling this follows:** objectui#7129 Q1-A rested on "the spec refuses `hideEmpty`". The director's dated note on #7129 records that premise as superseded by the objectui#8603 ruling (batch #137 item 3): spec 17.3.0+ declares the key, and objectui follows the protocol. `RecordDetailsRenderer` already reads it as `s.hideEmpty ?? true`, so nothing changes at runtime.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/record-components.ts`: the section entry declares `hideEmpty?: boolean`, with a doc comment covering the renderer default, `false` semantics, and that it is permitted beside `group`.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-section-members-8583.test.ts` (the #8583 pin), extended so the mirror cannot drift in either direction:
  - `_HideEmpty`: an invariant `Equal` of the member's type against the spec's `z.input` type.
  - `_KeySetMirrorsSpec`: `Equal` of `keyof Section` and `keyof SpecSection`. It goes red under `type-check` on a missing member or an extra one.
  - `_EveryMemberTypeMirrorsSpec`: a mapped `Equal` over every spec member, so a member added later on both sides is held to the spec's type without anyone writing a new line.
  - `MIRRORED_SECTION_KEYS` is tied to the type by `_ListIsTheTypesKeySet`. A vitest case then asserts that list equals the installed spec's section keys, sorted, so drift in either direction is also red under `vitest`, which strips types.
  - A runtime case: `hideEmpty: false` parses clean and survives the parse, both on an enumerated section and beside `group`. A control on the same position refuses a non-boolean value with `invalid_type` at `sections.0.hideEmpty`.
- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`: the `object-grid` `emptyState` describe now reads `{ title, message, icon, link }`. This is a text-only change: the schema is the spec `EmptyStateSchema` by reference, and that schema's shape has four keys on both next.0 and next.1.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: the `MEMBER_PINS` row `object-grid.emptyState` now says three of the four members are pinned there and names `link`'s pin, `ObjectGrid.emptyStateLink-12270.test.tsx`. This too is a text-only change inside a string literal.
- `.changeset/12348-details-sections-mirror.md`: `@object-ui/types` `minor`.

## Verification (head `80506a725`)

- `packages/types` `pnpm type-check` (all three legs: `tsc --noEmit`, examples, `tsconfig.test.json`): **exit 0**.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: **Test Files 381 passed (381), Tests 10577 passed (10577)**. The console file alone, run at the first commit: **255 passed (255)**.
- Pre-tsc battery, each `pnpm check:NAME` exit 0: `phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `new-line-citations`. Also exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors`: **exit 1**, "The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec in a consumer-facing field". This failure is already on `main` (objectui#12334). It is recorded here and left as it is.
- Lint, narrowed to the four changed `.ts` files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` returns 4 files in its JSON (none ignored by the config), with 0 errors and 1 warning. The warning is the existing `no-explicit-any` on the base file's `Equal of any` direction proof. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- **NOT MEASURED: console `type-check`.** The reason is `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: the workspace `dist/` for the console's dependency closure is not built in this container, so all 726 errors are module-resolution errors (`Cannot find module '@object-ui/...'`) and their cascades. The run never reached the console's own types. The console edit is a text change inside a string literal. Declared to CI.

## Ablations (one-off, each mutation verified on disk by `ablation-replace.mjs` and restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty)

1. **The base type with the new pin.** Deleting `hideEmpty?: boolean;` from the type made `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2 with errors on `_HideEmpty` (TS2339), `_KeySetMirrorsSpec`, `_EveryMemberTypeMirrorsSpec` and `_ListIsTheTypesKeySet` (TS2344), and TS2353 on both new `hideEmpty` literals. This is the card's own TS2353.
2. **The other direction.** Adding a member the spec lacks (`extraKeyTheSpecLacks?: boolean`) made it exit 2 with errors on `_KeySetMirrorsSpec` and `_ListIsTheTypesKeySet`. The first two attempts at this leg were no-ops: in each, the replacement text still contained the anchor, so the tool refused with "a drop of 0" and nothing was measured. The third attempt changed the anchor text itself.
3. **The runtime half.** Dropping `'hideEmpty'` from `MIRRORED_SECTION_KEYS` made vitest fail 1 test of 9, the new set-equality case, with the diff naming `"hideEmpty"`.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- The spec's `sections[].count` describe still reads "[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced] … until the record detail renderer reads it", while this type's `count` doc says `RecordDetailsRenderer` fills the hole (objectui#12192). This is spec-side describe text and outside this card's file surface. Carrier: none.
- The section entry's `collapsible` member has no doc comment, unlike its neighbours. This is polish only, and it is not changed here.

## Overlap

PR #12380 (another `.describe()` in `objectql.zod.ts`) landed before this branch merged `main`, and the auto-merge was clean.
